description: This file contains internal implementation details of the json-iterator library, including interfaces and functions for encoding and decoding JSON data, managing reflection-based decoders and encoders, and handling various data types.

classes.name: ctx
classes.description: Context structure holding configuration, prefix, and cached encoders/decoders.

classes.name: lazyErrorDecoder
classes.description: Decoder that reports an error when decoding unsupported types.

classes.name: lazyErrorEncoder
classes.description: Encoder that reports an error when encoding unsupported types.

classes.name: placeholderDecoder
classes.description: Placeholder for a decoder, used during decoder creation.

classes.name: placeholderEncoder
classes.description: Placeholder for an encoder, used during encoder creation.

classes.name: onePtrEncoder
classes.description: Encoder for pointer types that delegates to the underlying encoder.

methods.name: ReadVal
methods.description: Reads JSON data into a Go interface, similar to json.Unmarshal.

methods.name: WriteVal
methods.description: Writes a Go interface into JSON data, similar to json.Marshal.

methods.name: DecoderOf
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a decoder for a specific type.

methods.name: decoderOfType
methods.description: Creates a decoder for a specific type, considering extensions and type kind.

methods.name: _createDecoderOfType
methods.description: Internal function to create a decoder for a specific type, with fallback options.

methods.name: EncoderOf
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an encoder for a specific type.

methods.name: encoderOfType
methods.description: Creates an encoder for a specific type, considering extensions and type kind.

methods.name: _createEncoderOfType
methods.description: Internal function to create an encoder for a specific type, with fallback options.
